SMX is hiring a Data Engineer responsible for architecting, building, testing, and maintaining the data infrastructure for our mission partners. You will be responsible for a mix of data modeling and backend data mesh work, including creating data queries and performing SQL work. The ideal candidate will analyze and organize raw data, build robust data systems, and explore ways to enhance data quality and reliability. This role involves collaborating with analytics and business teams to transform raw information from different sources into high-quality, accessible data pipelines.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
+ Design, construct, test, and maintain highly scalable data management systems and robust ELT/ETL pipelines.
+ Build the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from various sources using cloud technologies, with a strong focus on AWS Glue, Glue Catalog, and Step Functions.
+ Support data migration efforts and ETL functions.
+ Optimize database schemas and build systems to collect, validate, and prepare data.
+ Combine raw information from different sources to meet business and mission needs.
+ Work with analytics and business teams to understand data requirements and deliver production-ready datasets
Required Skills & Experience
+ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, - Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field.
+ 3 years of professional experience in a data engineering or backend software engineering role.
+ Active Top Secret security clearance.
+ Strong proficiency in SQL and data query creation.
+ Hands-on experience with AWS services, specifically AWS Glue, Glue Catalog, and Step
+ Functions for data integration and workflow automation.
+ Experience with data modeling, data migration, and ETL functions.
+ Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interface with customers
Desired Skills & Experience
+ Experience supporting AI/ML pipelines, vectorization, or embedding generation
+ Experience with data governance, access controls, or sensitive data protection
+ Exposure to DevOps/CI-CD patterns for data workflows
+ Experience with Databricks
+ Experience with real-time data streaming and event-driven architectures

At SMX, one of our Core Values is to Invest in Our People so we offer a competitive mix of compensation, learning & development opportunities, and benefits. Some key components of our robust benefits include health insurance, paid leave, and retirement.
The proposed salary for this position is:
$95,500—$159,100 USD

Sr. Staff Data Engineer (Remote -Eligible)
As a Senior Staff Data Engineer at Capital One, you will be part of a community of technical experts working to define the future of data platforms and banking in the cloud. You will work alongside our talented team of data engineers, data scientists, machine learning experts, product managers and people leaders. Our Senior Staff Data Engineers are leading experts in their domains, helping devise practical, scalable and reusable data solutions to complex problems. You will drive innovation at multiple levels, helping optimize business outcomes while delivering strong data and technology solutions.
At Capital One, we believe diversity of thought strengthens our ability to influence, collaborate and provide the most innovative solutions across organizational boundaries. You will promote a culture of engineering excellence and strike the right balance between lending expertise and providing an inclusive environment where the ideas of others can be heard and championed. You will lead the way in creating next-generation talent for Capital One Tech, mentoring engineers and actively recruiting to keep building our community.
Senior Staff Data Engineers are expected to lead through technical contribution. You will operate as a trusted advisor for our key data technologies, platforms and capability domains, creating clear and concise communications, code samples, blog posts and other materials to share knowledge both inside and outside the organization. You will specialize in a particular subject area, but your input and impact will be sought and expected throughout the organization.
About the Team:
You will join the Pipelines and External Data team within Enterprise Data, serving as a Senior Director-level Individual Contributor (IC). This role demands a visionary and hands-on leader to drive the technical strategy for data pipelines and sharing capabilities leveraged by all lines of business inclusive of both internal and external data availability. Your focus is on driving innovation, best practices, engineering / delivery acceleration, platform scalability, operational excellence, performance, resiliency, and being a beacon for other ICs. We require deep expertise in AWS infrastructure, Lakehouse architecture, Kafka, Flink, Spark, Snowflake, and Databricks mature these enterprise-scale systems and execute technical strategy. You will be both visionary, influential, and hands-on writing Python, SQL, Java, and/or Scala code.
What You’ll Do:
+ Build awareness, increase knowledge and drive adoption of modern technologies, sharing consumer and engineering benefits to gain buy-in
+ Strike the right balance between lending expertise and providing an inclusive environment where others’ ideas can be heard and championed; leverage expertise to grow skills in the broader Capital One team
+ Promote a culture of engineering excellence, using opportunities to reuse and innersource solutions where possible
+ Effectively communicate with and influence key stakeholders across the enterprise, at all levels of the organization
+ Operate as a trusted advisor for a specific technology, platform or capability domain, helping to shape use cases and implementation in a unified manner
+ Lead the way in creating next-generation talent for Tech, mentoring internal talent and actively recruiting external talent to bolster Capital One’s Tech talent
+ Drive the strategic direction of the data engineering practice by continuously researching and assessing emerging trends in data, AI, and engineering, and developing a roadmap to integrate relevant innovations into the overall data platform
+ Lead strategic alignment and integration decisions across multiple data systems and business units, championing a unified data architecture that supports seamless, scalable, and governed data flow across the organization
+ Own the creation, management, and socialization of data strategy artifacts, ensuring comprehensive documentation is available to inform and guide enterprise-level decisions and initiatives (e.g., data governance policies, architecture blueprints, data product roadmaps)
+ Serve as a technical "force-multiplier," independently owning the end-to-end design and coding of critical data projects while influencing architectural standards and mentoring junior engineers to scale the team's capabilities and output
Basic Qualifications:
+ Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)
+ At least 9 years of experience in data engineering
+ At least 5 years of experience in data architecture
+ At least 3 years of experience building applications in AWS
+ At least 7 years of experience programming with at least one of the following languages: Python, Java, or Scala
+ At least 6 years of experience designing and developing data pipelines
+ At least 4 years of experience in data modeling and designing end-to-end data solutions using both relational and non-relational database systems
Preferred Qualifications:
+ Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field
+ 11+ years of experience in data engineering
+ 8+ years of data modeling experience
+ 3+ years of experience with ontology standards for defining a domain
+ 2+ years of experience deploying machine learning models
+ 12+ years of experience in application development with demonstrated proficiency in Python, SQL, Scala, or Java
+ 8+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying and operating data workloads in at least one public cloud environment (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud)
+ 8+ years of experience building or supporting distributed data or compute workloads using tools such as EMR, Spark, Glue, or Databricks
+ 8+ years of experience designing, implementing, and operating real-time or streaming data pipelines
+ 6+ years of experience working on data observability (e.g., Monte Carlo, Splunk) or data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Dagster)
+ 8+ years of experience with unstructured/semistructured data using NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB)
+ 8+ years of experience designing and supporting data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift)
+ 6+ years of experience working in an Agile development environment
+ 6+ years of experience developing user-centric reusable data products

About the role
As an AI Data Engineer, you will make an impact by designing, building, and optimizing scalable cloud-native data engineering solutions that enable advanced AI-driven applications and business outcomes. You will be a valued member of our engineering team and collaborate closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions across the AWS ecosystem.
In this role, you will:
+ Design, develop, and support scalable data pipelines, data integrations, and processing solutions using modern cloud-native technologies.
+ Build production-grade Python applications, scripts, and AWS Lambda functions that integrate with enterprise platforms, APIs, and AWS services.
+ Develop and enhance data platforms leveraging technologies such as AWS Glue, AWS DMS, Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, and Snowflake.
+ Translate business and technical requirements into engineering specifications, technical designs, and measurable acceptance criteria.
+ Review, validate, test, debug, and optimize AI-generated code while applying engineering best practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
Work model
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
What you need to have to be considered
+ Strong hands-on Python development experience with demonstrated success delivering production-quality code.
+ Proven data engineering experience building, deploying, and supporting scalable data pipelines and processing solutions.
+ Hands-on expertise with AWS services and cloud-native data engineering architectures.
+ Experience working with one or more of the following technologies: AWS Glue, AWS DMS, Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, or Snowflake.
+ Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Kiro, or similar technologies to accelerate software engineering while maintaining engineering rigor.
+ Ability to convert business requirements into technical specifications, solution designs, and acceptance criteria.
+ Experience reviewing, testing, debugging, and optimizing AI-generated code before production deployment.
+ Hands-on experience developing AWS Lambda functions using Python and integrating them with AWS services.
These will help you stand out
+ Experience with Kiro, including specification-driven development approaches.
+ Practical experience using Claude Code for software engineering or data engineering initiatives.
+ Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and MCP-based integrations.
+ Experience implementing automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and code-quality controls.
+ AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Data Engineer, AWS Certified Developer, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect.
+ Working knowledge of TypeScript.
+ Understanding of agentic AI engineering concepts, including agents, tools, memory, workflow orchestration, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Preferred differentiators
Candidates will stand out if they have experience with:
+ Agent development frameworks such as Strands Agents SDK or similar agentic AI platforms.
+ Designing and implementing MCP servers, tools, and integrations.
+ Creating reusable engineering standards, development patterns, specifications, and governance practices for AI-assisted development.
+ Building agentic workflows and orchestration solutions that interact with AWS services, enterprise systems, APIs, and data platforms.
+ Applying AI-assisted engineering throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements definition and code generation to testing, deployment, and operational support.
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Applications will be accepted until November 29, 2026
The annual salary for this position is between $ 100,000 - $ 115,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.
This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance

Role Overview
Cognizant is seeking an experienced Knowledge Graph Data Engineer to build and operate the connectivity, profiling, and graph/search foundation that powers enterprise ontology and knowledge management platforms.
In this role, you will be responsible for transforming raw operational and master data sources into clean, lineage-tracked, governed, and queryable knowledge assets. You will design and support data connectivity, metadata management, graph platforms, ingestion frameworks, and search capabilities that enable scalable knowledge discovery and enterprise intelligence solutions.
The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), data engineering, metadata management, graph technologies, data lineage, and scalable ingestion architectures.
Work Model
This position is fully remote within the United States , providing flexibility while collaborating with globally distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.
Occasional travel may be required for client workshops, planning sessions, architecture reviews, and strategic initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Data Connectivity & Integration
+ Design, develop, and maintain connectivity solutions for enterprise data sources.
+ Build adapters and integration frameworks supporting:
+ BigQuery
+ Cloud SQL
+ REST APIs
+ Apigee
+ Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
+ Pub/Sub
+ Establish scalable and reliable ingestion patterns for operational, transactional, and master data systems.
+ Support API-based integrations across enterprise applications and data platforms.
Data Profiling & Metadata Management
+ Profile enterprise data to assess:
+ Data Quality
+ Completeness
+ Statistical Patterns
+ Dependencies
+ Data Relationships
+ Source System Characteristics
+ Develop data discovery frameworks that support ontology and semantic model development.
+ Build metadata management processes supporting data governance, traceability, and analytics.
+ Surface data quality issues and metadata findings to architecture and business teams.
Knowledge Graph & Search Platform Engineering
+ Design and operate the enterprise Knowledge Core supporting graph-based data exploration and search.
+ Implement graph and knowledge management platforms utilizing:
+ Spanner Graph
+ Neo4j
+ Amazon Neptune
+ TigerGraph
+ RDF/SPARQL Technologies
+ Equivalent Graph Platforms
+ Support graph data modeling, relationship management, and semantic search capabilities.
+ Enable enterprise-scale graph analytics and knowledge discovery use cases.
Batch & Streaming Data Engineering
+ Build and maintain batch and real-time data pipelines that continuously synchronize source data with graph and catalog platforms.
+ Design ingestion architectures utilizing:
+ Dataflow
+ Apache Beam
+ Pub/Sub
+ Cloud Composer
+ Event-Driven Architectures
+ Ensure data pipelines remain scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient.
+ Support near real-time updates across ontology and knowledge graph environments.
Data Governance, Quality & Lineage
+ Implement automated data quality controls and validation frameworks.
+ Support schema discovery and metadata catalog capabilities.
+ Capture and maintain end-to-end data lineage from source systems through graph and ontology representations.
+ Establish governance controls including:
+ IAM Policies
+ Encryption Standards
+ Metadata Tracking
+ Lineage Instrumentation
+ Partner with architecture and governance teams to ensure compliance with enterprise standards.
Ontology & AI Enablement
+ Support ontology mapping activities by providing:
+ Profiled Schemas
+ Data Dependency Maps
+ Sample Data Sets
+ Metadata Context
+ Deliver curated and well-profiled datasets supporting machine learning and entity-resolution initiatives.
+ Collaborate with Data Scientists and Applied AI teams to improve data quality and knowledge graph accuracy.
+ Enable graph-based AI use cases, entity matching, semantic search, and inference capabilities.
Monitoring, Reliability & Optimization
+ Monitor platform health, ingestion jobs, graph-processing workloads, and metadata services.
+ Troubleshoot data and pipeline issues and implement preventative solutions.
+ Optimize performance, scalability, and operational efficiency across the platform stack.
+ Manage cost optimization initiatives across cloud infrastructure and processing workloads.

+ 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Data Platform Engineering.
+ Proven experience building large-scale ingestion, metadata, and data management solutions.
+ Strong expertise in:
+ Python
+ SQL

+ BigQuery
+ Dataflow
+ Pub/Sub
+ Cloud Composer
+ Cloud SQL

+ Metadata Management
+ Data Quality Frameworks
